name: Uoza Pikushizu
source:
He’s mysterious, romantic, and sweet: the Prince of Pisces.

Possessing a delicate sensibility, he is able to read people’s feelings instantly. He values inspiration and treasures the unseen world more than anything. He is calm and gentle to the core, and somewhat out of touch with the world. Therefore, he tends to get distracted in the middle of conversations. He wants to live a relaxed life and laying about at home is the norm for him. He is very spoiled and good at getting what he wants.

He wants to live a relaxed life and laying about at home is the norm for him. He is very spoiled and good at getting what he wants.
